## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(boot)
```

## #2 Set seed

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## #3 Import Data

```{r}
data <- read.csv(here("results","drug_effects.csv"))
```

## #4 Choose Correlation Values

```{r}
nint = 56
correlations_between_models = c(0.8, 0.9, 0.95)
corr_LOIO = c(0.36, 0.45, 0.53)
```

## #5 Simulated Effect Data Function

```{r}
simulated_data <- function(corr_between_models=0.8, corr_LODO = 0.53, corr_LOIO = 0.36) {

  cor_matrix <- matrix(
    c(
      1,   corr_LODO, corr_LOIO,
      corr_LODO, 1,   corr_between_models,
      corr_LOIO, corr_between_models, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  R <- chol(cor_matrix)
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(nint * 3), nrow = nint, ncol = 3)
  
  effects <- Z %*% R

  return(effects)
}
```

## #6 Correlation Function

```{r}
corr <- function(df, met="pearson") {
  
  corr_lodo = cor(df$Lifespan, df$Clock_LODO, method = met)
  corr_loio = cor(df$Lifespan, df$Clock_LOIO, method = met)
  
  delta_corr = corr_lodo - corr_loio
  
  correlation = c(delta_corr, corr_lodo, corr_loio)
  
  return (correlation)
}
```

## #7 Bootstrap Delta R Function

```{r}
delta_corr <- function(data, indices) {
  sample <- data[indices, ]
  
  RLODO <- cor(sample[, 1], sample[, 2])
  RLOIO <- cor(sample[, 1], sample[, 3])
  
  R=RLODO - RLOIO
  return(R)
}
```

## #8 Simulate 1000 Times

```{r}
results <- data.frame()

potencia <- data.frame(
  Intervention = paste0("Drug_", 1:nint),
  Lifespan = numeric(nint),
  Clock_LODO = numeric(nint),
  Clock_LOIO = numeric(nint)
)

R_LODO_LOIO=data.frame(
  R_LODO=numeric(),
  R_LOIO=numeric()
)

for (correlation_LOIO in corr_LOIO) {
  
  for (corr_value in correlations_between_models) {
    
    delta_corr_values <- numeric(1000)
    
    bootstrap_values <- vector("list", 1000)
    
    CI <- data.frame(
      p5 = numeric(1000),
      p95 = numeric(1000)
    )
    
    for (i in 1:1000) {
      effects <- simulated_data(
        corr_between_models = corr_value,
        corr_LOIO = correlation_LOIO)
      df <- potencia
      df[, 2:4] <- effects
      correlations=corr(df)
      delta_corr_values[i] <- correlations[[1]]
      
      boot_results = boot(
        data = effects,
        statistic = delta_corr,
        R = 1000
      )
      
      R_LODO_LOIO = rbind(R_LODO_LOIO, data.frame(
        R_LODO = correlations[2],
        R_LOIO = correlations[3]
      ))
      
      
      CI$p5[i] <- quantile(boot_results$t, probs = 0.05)
      CI$p95[i] <- quantile(boot_results$t, probs = 0.95)
    }
    
    LB_under_zero=sum(CI$p5 <= 0)
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      nint = nint,
      corr_LOIO_Lifespan = correlation_LOIO,
      corr_between_models = corr_value,
      Mean_delta_r = mean(delta_corr_values),
      Percentile_Range_CI95 =
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.975) -
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.025),
      Percentile_Range_CI90 =
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.95) -
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.05),
      r_LODO = mean(R_LODO_LOIO$R_LODO),
      r_LOIO = mean(R_LODO_LOIO$R_LOIO),
      n_LB_under_zero = LB_under_zero,
      potencia = 1-LB_under_zero/1000
    ))
  }
}

results
```

## #9 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(results,
          here("results","potencia_lodo_loio.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
